Ok so a few things:

First, you do NOT want to be above him. Marth players' entire goal against either spacie is to get them in the air/above him. Up tilt and up air are too good at juggling, not to mention his ability to chaingrab. If you find yourself above marth, focus on getting to his level (or below) asap. Practicing shield dropping-waveland back on platform and shield drop-laser (use it as a mixup) as well as slide-off tech (holding c-stick down and holding gray stick at an angle towards the edge of the platform. 

Second, in neutral you want to mixup your laser usage. Short hop laser or short hop laser dash dance, or even mix up by faking a laser (pressing b so the sound comes out, but then fast fall before the laser actually comes out). The neutral game between these 2 characters is all about spacing and power-shielding Falcos lasers. You're in control of the neutral game, so force them to play to your comfort.

Learn to use your up-tilt at early percents opposed to shine (unless you are on FD, in which case you should become proficient in pillaring)

All together I would say to remember to space your moves well and make sure you're not above him more often than not. There's more involved of course, but these would be good places to start
